messages:
emily: Heads-up: when you paste a param snippet into the schema editor without a "type" we save and show a top banner that just says "Schema invalid". Users don't know which param to fix.

sam: Yikes. Pastes are common — we should surface the exact node and let people jump there.

emily: Repro: new fn -> add param -> paste {"name":"email"} -> save -> banner. No inline indicator.

kai: That's because we only do full validation on save for perf. We kept a single banner to avoid continuous checks.

emily: Could we do a debounced lint on the edited subtree (e.g., 600ms) and show a small inline icon with a tooltip? Banner stays for fatal issues.

aisha: Accessibility: banner alone isn't enough. We need an assertive announcement that includes node name and a focusable "Jump to error" control. Keyboard-friendly: Enter should jump, focus should land on the problematic field.

sam: Proposed inline tooltip copy: "Missing required field: \"type\". Press Enter or click to focus this parameter."

kai: Dev idea: run a lightweight JSONSchema check limited to the changed node, show inline icon button with aria-label="schema error: missing type", debounce 600ms, keep banner for save failures.

emily: Banner copy tweak: "Schema validation failed — see inline markers for details." Softer and actionable.

aisha: Visual/a11y: ensure the icon color meets 4.5:1 contrast at small sizes (current #ff6b6b fails). Recommend #b00020 or add a white halo. Touch target >=44px and clear focus ring. Announce: "Schema error in parameter 'email': missing type. Press Enter to jump."

sam: Related: run history shows tool-call payload as a raw blob. For structured output, show a compact preview row listing top-level keys and types, with an expand button that reveals the tree. Use aria-expanded/aria-controls and lazy-load the full payload.

kai: Server-side can return a compact preview (first 3 keys + types) to avoid shipping big JSONs. Client renders a semantic list and fetches only on expand.

emily: Example preview: "result: object {status: string, items: array}" — clickable to expand into an inspector with copy/search.

aisha: Keyboard: make expand button reachable, move focus into the tree on open, support arrow navigation, and announce expansion changes politely.

design-bot: Created tickets: "playground-inline-lint+jump", "run-history-preview+keyboard", "copy tweak: schema banner". Assigning @sam, @kai.

emily: Can @sam post a tiny mock of the inline tooltip and the run-history preview before next design review?

sam: Yep, will post mockups tomorrow in #design-review.

kai: I'll prototype debounce + aria-live behavior and test with VO.

aisha: I'll schedule a quick keyboard/VO pass once prototype is ready.
